## Changes since 9.3.0-dzbarsky19

- Filter registered native toolchain declarations by the requested canonical toolchain type before configured analysis. Declarations for unrelated native types are no longer configured; declaration aliases and configurable type aliases remain supported. Malformed declarations retain normal error reporting under `--keep_going`, with a regression test for a missing `toolchain_type`. Based on [dzbarsky/bazel#8](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/8/changes/f9f33ac90afdee0f702ac4906ad3f425ed90747e).
- Rebase onto upstream [`release-9.3.0` at `0a21ca77ac`](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/commit/0a21ca77ac8a1c23b4da3818a8707b1cf13510cf), adding the `PatchUtil` fix for patches containing `\ No newline at end of file` markers ([bazelbuild/bazel#31036](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/31036)).

### Compatibility

Analysis errors in unused native toolchain declarations may now be deferred until their toolchain type is requested. The upstream cancellation and cleanup fixes for rewound output uploads are retained; release 19 already included the equivalent backport. All other release 19 patches are preserved.

### Release publication

This release is immutable and includes Linux and macOS binaries for x86_64 and arm64, with SHA-256 checksums and build-provenance attestations.
